summary.en: Famous fortuneteller Sadako Barbara was found murdered in her own house. Moreover, there are evidences suggesting that three people, all possess vendetta against her fortunetelling, are involved in this crime. Who among the three is the real culprit? Because the victim was a well-liked fortuneteller, the police are able to narrow down the list of suspects to three people: Shinsuke Kanawa, Fukami Endo, and Ryoichi Sazanami, all of which have grudge against the victim for supposedly gave the fortune that had instead brought them misfortune. Additionally, all three of them each has their own possession involved in the crime: Endo's broach was found in the same room that Baba was discovered, Kanawa's lighter was found in the park she was strangled, and Sazanami's car was used to transport the victim's body from the park to her house.
